subpages.text: Skip to Content 0 My Cart Sign in Home KidGuard WOCD AutoArm Automation Shop Contact us About Contact Us 0 Home KidGuard WOCD AutoArm Automation Shop Contact us About Sign in Contact Us About Us Visionar Window Systems designs and builds innovative window products Our Story The History that Led to Innovation After Bruce built and sold Canada’s largest property management company and Brent spent 10 years in auditing and CFO roles as a CPA, the father-son team bought a window and glass shop, which they transitioned into a commercial glazing company that manufactured and installed storefronts, curtain walls, and doors throughout Greater Vancouver. After seeing limited innovation and the high cost of many industry products, they began developing their own solutions, establishing supply chains, and partnering with manufacturers to bring new products to market. They eventually began selling their products to other glazing contractors and discovered that their passion was innovation and product development. In October 2024, they sold their glazing company to focus on developing innovative products through Visionar Window Systems Inc. Development of AutoArm Automated Casement Window Hardware AutoArm is a simple, affordable window automation system that controls window operation through a controller, smart home app or wall switch. Just as push buttons replaced hand cranks in cars and wall switches replaced pull strings to turn on household lights, our goal is for AutoArm to become the preferred way to operate windows. Concealed within the frame, AutoArm opens, closes, and securely locks windows while delivering the convenience of automation.
